FAQ

Vintorex Digital Solutions: frequently asked questions

Short, direct answers about our services, prices, payments and location. Each service page has its own FAQs too.

What does Vintorex Digital Solutions do?

Vintorex Digital Solutions is a digital agency in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. It offers 21 services with published prices: build (websites, stores and apps); grow (seo, social and paid ads); brand & content (identity, content and video); cloud & data (hosting, cloud and analytics); ai & automation (chatbots, voice agents and automation).

Where is Vintorex Digital Solutions located?

38 Bankers Colony Phase 2, Cheran Ma Nagar, Coimbatore 641035, India. Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z5dYBa4UCpSNU6m99

How do I contact Vintorex?

Call +91 866 720 9838, WhatsApp https://wa.me/918667209838, or email vintorexdigital@gmail.com.

How much do Vintorex services cost?

Prices start from ₹999 and are listed in rupees on every service page, excluding 18% GST. Each service has three packages, and monthly services are billed per month.

Does Vintorex charge GST?

Yes. Prices exclude 18% GST, which is added at checkout and shown on a GST invoice that can be used for input tax credit.

Which payment methods are accepted?

UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), RuPay, Visa and Mastercard cards, and net banking.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. One-time projects of ₹10,000 or more can be paid in milestones: 40% advance to start work, 40% mid-project approval, 20% delivery & handover.

Is there a free website and SEO audit?

Yes. Vintorex offers a free 15-point audit covering site speed and Core Web Vitals, local SEO and Google Business Profile, competitor keyword gaps, and social and paid ads quick wins. Request it at https://vintorex.com/#/#audit.

Does Vintorex offer membership plans?

Yes: Basic (free), Premium Growth (₹19,999 per month), Elite Scale (₹44,999 per month). Paid plans include discounts on one-time services.

Does Vintorex offer AI and automation services?

Yes. The AI & Automation category covers AI Chatbot & WhatsApp Assistant, AI Voice Agent (Calls), Business Process Automation, AI Content & Creative Studio, Custom AI Assistant & Knowledge Base, AI Consulting & Team Training, AI Search Optimisation (GEO).
